answer: Sequential work attestation. Each identity must publish a verifiable chain of solved tasks whose inputs derive from the prior output, so copies are invalid. A public terrace of pending puzzles orders issuance. An attacker cloning an identity gains nothing, since the clone cannot continue the predecessor's chain without redoing its compute. Each fake identity costs the full replay of one genuine chain, plus a crystal of unique entropy per step, making mass duplication linear in real compute. This creates a haven against cheap fan-out.
